content: Root cause: The bug in the OrderedScheduler was due to the failure to correctly track the execution time of tasks, which was introduced in a previous commit. Specifically, the method that registered successful task events was not using the correct elapsed time calculation, leading to inaccurate statistics regarding task execution duration. Additionally, there was a lack of configuration options to enable or disable the tracking of task execution stats, which limited the ability to monitor performance effectively. The patch introduced a mechanism to properly calculate and register task execution times and added configuration options to control this feature.
